experience.title: Web Developer
experience.subtitle: SNS Technology
experience.text: I build and deploy WordPress websites, taking projects from development through to launch. Most of my work is in development, with smaller design adjustments along the way to help pages look and work as intended. I work across sites at different stages, following each build through to the point where people can use it.

experience.title: Tech Developer
experience.subtitle: Alef Solutions, National Capital District
experience.text: I worked alongside a backend developer to build Attendo's frontend with React and Next.js, deploy it on Vercel and support live pilot events. I set up email delivery with Resend and contributed to the AWS Cognito registration integration. Alongside the application work, I built and maintained WordPress sites, looked after content, domains and SSL, and prepared monthly performance reports. The role took me from building features to supporting them in use.

experience.title: Lead Full Stack Developer
experience.subtitle: Be Pacific Digital Agency, National Capital District
experience.text: I joined as a Full Stack Developer and later moved into the lead role, designing and developing websites and web applications for clients including Agora Education & Training Institute, Abus Na Kumu, the Business Council of Papua New Guinea and Be Pacific Digital Agency. I also looked after existing sites for Atlas Steel, St John PNG and The Healthy Food Company. Along the way, I built a reusable WordPress plugin and introduced Google Analytics and Data Studio reporting, balancing new builds with the ongoing care that client websites need.

experience.title: Freelance Developer

experience.text: I help businesses and organisations build and look after their websites, from design and development through to deployment and maintenance. I also help with hosting, domains, SSL and email setup, taking care of the practical details that keep a website running after launch.
